reason: Answer the optimality question flagged three times in R0036: the number of primitive prime divisors of Phi_n(b) is bounded by phi(n) log(b+1)/log(n+1) without factoring, which is polylogarithmic where the cost is exponential, so cheapest-first is optimal outside a bounded window and undecided inside it. The organ now reports the size of that window instead of claiming optimality.
